description: Complete the act: pass act, the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_collectible UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/collectibles, or its /:id/withdraw); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself and keeps its own free daily limit for one connection. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the holder wallet. A commemorative gives no right to anything. The program is held off until the operator switches it on, with a house price set; this tool moves no NET and holds none, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Ask net_collectible_status where the record stands, because Vealth sends no email. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.
